data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Still no correct refund](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a830d54a65bc070dfab5ebd)
I have not been refunded for items I have sent back with UPS as requested with the code they emailed. Although....they have refunded me, for items I bought during the same period which, I like, I want to keep, and I did not EVER return. Yet,I received a refund them. I have been going back and forth with the online customer service. The last email they sent me has attached a code so I can send back the order, I already did! I really want to get my money back for products I have returned.

July 13, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 18, 2026

Hi Marie,

Thank you for your feedback! We are so sorry to hear you experienced difficulties with your returns. Our Return process for items that ship ground are shipped back through FedEx not UPS. Please follow up with your return tracking information for your order, and our Customer support team is glad to confirm that the items were received at our returns warehouse.

Lulu and Georgia
